# One link is one problem

An activity link is a single problem in one activity, and carries nothing else. There are no problem lists, saved activity links, starter problems, session limits or end-of-session reports, unlike Morphology Mash. The teacher page makes one activity link at a time. We chose the simplest thing that works in class: a teacher who wants five problems shares five activity links. Lists, ordering and reports can be added later if teachers ask for them; until then, don't add them back as a matter of course.
